notes: bpy wheels are built against exactly one CPython minor version. Python must be 3.13 for bpy 5.2.x.
Blender 5.2 LTS released 2026-07-14, supported to July 2028. Pin the LTS series for the whole arc; do not chase 5.3 mid-arc.
The render node runs the native Blender 5.2 install, not the wheel, because the CLI contract (--threads, --log, -E, -F) is what the farm path is built on.
